methods: Firecrawl prompt-only JSON maxAge=0 (no schema supplied)

acquisition.timestamp_precision: curl retrieved_at uses download file mtime; Firecrawl retrieved_at uses local response persistence time, an upper bound after acquisition, not a server fetch timestamp.

tool_trials.name: withdrawal prompt-only JSON
tool_trials.semantic_support: withdrawal target/scope correct; absent date fields are literal strings null, not JSON null

validation.inspected_examples: expected roles/dates matched; not a blind benchmark
validation.shared_validator: passed: 10 artifacts, 10 observations, 11 exact quotes; report shared-validation.json
validation.canonical_event_types: proposal and withdrawal; uppercase source labels preserved as exact evidence

comparison.clean_text: Retains both notices' relevant header/body dates and labels, with escaped brackets and RCW links. Local div text is simpler for exact quotations and parsing.
comparison.model_value: Identifies partial withdrawal semantics and abstains semantically on future dates, but adds shape repair work. No operational need demonstrated for these two known templates.
comparison.metadata_timezone: Firecrawl metadata says America/New_York; not source evidence for Washington filing/hearing timezone and ignored.

source_specific_rules: Index PROP is issue category, not event_type or an open-window assertion.
14 PROP rows refer to 13 native IDs; 26-18-066 appears under two agency listings.
Use WSR native ID parsed from notice header; URL identity tracked in manifest separately.
Agency name can span multiple divs.
Filing datetime timezone unstated: retain local_datetime without IANA/UTC.
Only labeled Submit Written Comments field supplies comment close; accommodation date is distinct even when equal.
Date of Intended Adoption is not effective_date; historical amendment effective dates are not current notice effectivity.
Partial withdrawal scope is independent of target native ID.
limitations: Only one issue index and two selected notices; no statewide completeness.
Parser supports two guarded body-event templates and particular English date syntax; aborts on changes rather than silently guessing.
Withdrawal relation regex could need human review on different language.
No claim about legal authority, inclusive end-of-day cutoff, receipt/postmark, or later replacement filing.
No schema-constrained model trial performed; prompt-only connector accepted.
No corrections applied to raw model output; model output not merged into observations.
shared_format_change_requests: Consider a dedicated intended_adoption_date predicate if future scope requires it; current SPEC lacks one, so no assertion emitted.
Consider issue-category metadata distinct from event_type; retained in index-enumeration.json for this spike.
unexpected_results: Initial replay rejected proposal filing header because agency name occupied two divs; parser now locates guarded filing header and preserves agency evidence across divs.
First shared validator run rejected source_lineage arrays. Updated manifest generator to emit nonempty lineage identifier strings per primary guidance; rerun passed.
format_clarifications: Primary-owned research clarification: canonical event_type values proposal/withdrawal mapped from guarded WSR body labels; source artifacts and expectations recorded before extraction remain unchanged.
